name: research-copilot
displayName: Research Copilot - NotebookLM for VS Code
description: Turn your PDF research materials into an AI-powered knowledge base. Query, summarize, and cross-reference your documents using GitHub Copilot.

researchCopilot.autoIndex.description: Automatically index PDF files when opened or added to workspace

researchCopilot.extractImages.description: Extract and process images from PDFs

researchCopilot.ocrEnabled.description: Enable OCR for scanned PDFs and images

researchCopilot.indexPath.description: Folder to store index data (relative to workspace root)

researchCopilot.maxPdfSizeMB.description: Maximum PDF file size to process (in MB)

researchCopilot.chunkSize.description: Text chunk size for indexing (in characters)

researchCopilot.useDocxConversion.description: Use enhanced PDF conversion via DOCX (better for images, tables, and complex layouts). Requires Python - dependencies are auto-installed on first use.

chatParticipants.name: research
chatParticipants.description: Ask questions about your research documents, PDFs, and notes

languageModelTools.name: researchCopilot_searchDocuments
languageModelTools.description: Search through indexed PDF documents and research materials. Use this to find relevant information from the user's research papers and documents.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Search through indexed PDF documents and research materials. Use this to find relevant information from the user's research papers and documents.

query.description: The search query to find relevant documents and passages

maxResults.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 10)

documentFilter.description: Optional filter to search within specific documents (filename pattern)

languageModelTools.name: researchCopilot_getDocumentContent
languageModelTools.description: Get the full extracted content of a specific PDF document
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get the full extracted content of a specific PDF document

documentPath.description: The path to the document to retrieve

languageModelTools.name: researchCopilot_listDocuments
languageModelTools.description: List all indexed research documents in the workspace
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List all indexed research documents in the workspace

includeMetadata.description: Include document metadata (page count, size, etc.)

languageModelTools.name: researchCopilot_getDocumentImages
languageModelTools.description: Get images extracted from a PDF document with their descriptions
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get images extracted from a PDF document with their descriptions

pageNumber.description: Optional specific page number to get images from

languageModelTools.name: researchCopilot_summarizeDocument
languageModelTools.description: Get a summary of a specific document or section
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get a summary of a specific document or section

documentPath.description: The path to the document to summarize

languageModelTools.name: researchCopilot_semanticSearch
languageModelTools.description: AI-powered semantic search using embeddings. Better at understanding meaning and context than keyword search. Use for conceptual queries.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: AI-powered semantic search using embeddings. Better at understanding meaning and context than keyword search. Use for conceptual queries.

query.description: The semantic search query - can be a question or concept description

maxResults.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 10)

documentFilter.description: Optional filter to search within specific documents

languageModelTools.name: researchCopilot_getCitations
languageModelTools.description: Extract academic citations and references from a document. Detects APA, MLA, IEEE, Harvard, and other citation styles.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Extract academic citations and references from a document. Detects APA, MLA, IEEE, Harvard, and other citation styles.

documentPath.description: The path to the document to extract citations from

languageModelTools.name: researchCopilot_getHighlights
languageModelTools.description: Retrieve highlights and annotations the user has made on their research documents
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Retrieve highlights and annotations the user has made on their research documents

color.description: Optional: filter highlights by color (yellow, green, blue, pink, purple, orange)

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
